item.title: Olá. Hello. こんにち.
item.description: Bio I’m João Victor, a software engineer at Google. I have a Computer Science degree from Universidade Federal de São Carlos. During my professional career I’ve dabbled in a variety of languages and technologies. Most of my recent professional work has been creating new Supervision APIs in the Android Open Source Project. I also have extensive experience creating back-end services, some light UI work using Google internal frameworks and creating a new version of Family Link using Flutter.
